'''Narglatch AirTech''' was a small, independent development firm in operation during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Narglatch manufactured [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and speeder [[Narglatch AirTech prefabricated kit|custom kits]] for wealthy hobbyists across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Their products attracted the attention of many influential Senators and Core Worlders in the Republic, including the playboy senator of [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]], [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]]. Narglatch AirTech produced the [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]] purchased by Greyshade and the [[XJ-2 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-2]] model flown by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
